{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_count}")

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Total completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")

# Exclude internal test orders from completed orders
completed_valid = completed_orders[~internal_test_mask]
print(f"Valid completed orders (excluding test): {len(completed_valid)}")

# Compute total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = completed_valid['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from valid completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
